title: Ben Tadal
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Chullin 134a Resh Lakish said to Rabbi Yochanan: “Do not teach it except in the language of Ben Tadal.” Rashi explains that Ben Tadal was the name of a fool. Hyman cites the Arukh under Ben Adal for the explanation that he was a man who was not careful with his traditions.

notes.text: The consulted Arukh prints the entry under Ben Arel and records Adal with dalet as a variant. It gives the explanation about imprecision in reporting traditions for that variant.
